title: Maximum Product Subarray
contract: Return the largest product of a nonempty contiguous subarray. Input is nonempty and every subarray product fits long.
brute: long best=Long.MIN_VALUE;for(int l=0;l<a.length;l++){long product=1;for(int r=l;r<a.length;r++){product*=a[r];best=Math.max(best,product);emit("Extend a candidate product","range",new int[]{l,r},"product",product,"best",best);}}return best;
optimal: long high=a[0],low=a[0],best=a[0];for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++){long x=a[i],aHigh=high*x,aLow=low*x;high=Math.max(x,Math.max(aHigh,aLow));low=Math.min(x,Math.min(aHigh,aLow));best=Math.max(best,high);emit("Track both signs because a negative reverses order","index",i,"maximum ending",high,"minimum ending",low,"best",best);}return best;
reasoning: Enumerate subarrays and extend their products incrementally.
A negative current value can turn the smallest previous product into the largest current product.
Track both extrema ending here and compute both new values from the old pair. A zero naturally restarts candidates; initializing the answer to zero fails for a single negative input.
